claim_summary: For the cube graph, the two-matching complex is a wedge of three five-spheres; its rational homology carries the sign-twisted natural signed-permutation module of the full cube automorphism group.
integrity: Finite exhaustive chain and acyclic-matching computations are replayable from the included standard-library script and its checked certificate. Same-model review only; no independent external assessment.
scientific_limitations: Only the eight-vertex three-cube is analyzed.
The symmetry identification concerns rational homology, not an integral lattice or equivariant homotopy equivalence.
No higher-dimensional hypercube family classification is asserted.
Potential indexed sources available only as summaries leave a bibliographic completeness risk.
title: The cube two-matching complex and its twisted signed-permutation homology
